scientific.integrity: The practical Sophia update is specialized exactly to a diagonal positive quadratic with exact current Hessian and disabled moment memory. The recurrence becomes a coordinatewise clipped affine map whose global dynamics can be classified completely.
limitations: Exact diagonal Hessian refreshed every step.
No first-moment memory, Hessian EMA, or weight decay.
Diagonal positive quadratic in the optimizer coordinate basis.
Finite-time convergence at the resonance is not claimed for stochastic or nonquadratic training.

title: Sophia has a sharp clipping-stability boundary and a finite-time resonance
